title: Debugging Drupal session is a go for Paris Drupalcon | RandyFay.com
primaryHeading: Debugging Drupal session is a go for Paris Drupalcon
lines: I just got an email that my Debugging Drupal session for Drupalcon Paris is a go! I had already been told that none of my sessions went, so it was quite a surprise. Should be a good session. And the CTools Plugin session, which didn't go, will be done as a BOF add-on to the big session by MerlinOfChaos on CTools in general.
